description: This file implements the Cassandra-based clustering membership table for Orleans. It manages membership entries, including their creation, update, deletion, and querying, using Cassandra as the backend data store.

classes.name: CassandraClusteringTable
classes.description: Implements the Orleans IMembershipTable interface using Cassandra backend for managing cluster membership data.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the Cassandra session and membership table, creating necessary schema if needed.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all membership entries for a specific cluster ID, with validation.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Inserts a new membership entry if it does not already exist or if the existing version is older.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Updates an existing membership entry based on the provided table version.

methods.name: GetMembershipEntry
methods.description: Converts a Cassandra row into a MembershipEntry object.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads all membership entries from Cassandra.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific row identified by SiloAddress.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive timestamp for a specific membership entry, with TTL considerations.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes inactive or defunct silo entries older than a specified date.
